To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) a language-model based method for query informed text segmentation is a viable approach to extracting relevant passages from documents, and (b) this method is particularly useful in the context of a digital library system for the visually impaired.

(1) language model based segmentation is an effective way to extract relevant passages from documents; (2) language model based text segmentation can be used to improve the accuracy of passage retrieval systems.

(1) language model based text segmentation is an effective method for extracting relevant information from Web pages, and (2) the performance of the language model based segmentation is significantly better than that of the traditional keyword-based methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of finding the relevant passages in a given document.
the problem of identifying the most relevant passages for a given query, and the problem of highlighting relevant terms in the retrieved passages.
developing techniques that can help reduce the navigations cost of end users by automatically extracting relevant snippets and highlighting the relevant parts of a long document.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have presented algorithms to extract relevant snippets from a Web document based on a language model of the document.
our method of extracting relevant snippets from Web documents through language-model based text segmentation is a novel approach to query-oriented document representation.

the language model based approach for passage detection and snippet extraction is a viable alternative to the keyword based approach, and that it is especially useful for queries which are not keyword oriented.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a language model based approach for accurate and efficient detection of the most relevant passages in documents.
we have developed a novel method for text segmentation and have applied it to extract the most relevant passage from a document to a given query.
we present a novel approach for query-oriented segmentation of documents, which can be used in various information retrieval applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the language model based segmentation of a document into relevant snippets is a promising approach for query-oriented document summarization.

a simple language model based segmentation algorithm can help extract relevant snippets from a document, which is useful for a wide range of applications, such as search result summarization, query-oriented document segmentation and query-oriented document summarization.
language models can be used to effectively characterize the semantic relevance of various parts in a document.
